title: chats-blob — case shape (v0.2)
description: Pins the migrated conversation-file envelope (MYJ5, §10.4.1, myne-md/myne#675): the v0.2 seal (v0.2 KEK via derive_subkey_versioned + v0.2 AAD) over the same payload bytes, and the bidirectional generation refusal. Unlike the catalog/themes singletons, the conversation-file header version byte IS the generation (0x02 here). Two case kinds: 'encrypt' (decode-verified fixture + magic/version pins) and 'decode_fail_v0_1' (the v0.1 expectation refuses MYJ5 at the magic check, before any decryption). The Rust reference implementation lives at protocol/src/chats_blob.rs (main myne repository).

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'chats-blob/v0.2/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

input_root_key_hex.description: 32-byte root_key (hex). The runner derives the v0.2 file KEK via derive_subkey_versioned(V0_2, root_key, ChatsKey).

input_plaintext_hex.description: Canonical turn-list payload JSON bytes (hex), same bytes the v0.1 envelope seals.

expected_magic_ascii.description: The migrated conversation-file magic. Read straight off the expected bytes by the runner.

expected_version_byte_hex.description: The conversation-file header version byte IS the generation (0x02 here) — unlike the catalog/themes singletons, whose byte stays 0x01.

oneOf.title: decode_fail_v0_1 — pin the v0.1 expectation refusing MYJ5

expected_error.description: The v0.1 expectation refuses a next-major blob at the magic check, before any decryption.
